units.rationale: Ordering is empty and sharedState declares only presentation-fixtures-ready schema fixture-set.presentation-tour@2, which preparation:presentation-fixtures-device produces at call 36 with dependsOnTags app.session, certificate.trust, fixture.corpus, lane.instance, library.contents, presentation.state, source.connection, source.webdav (Regression/preparations/presentation-fixtures-device.md:336-353). Empty ordering is correct because no scenario produces that key and harness.reset-product-state@2 in the preparation is rebuilt per lease via runtime.py:1771-1810, so no MainGate join forms and no spurious edge exists.

All seven calls resolve on device lane: app.relaunch@1 (adapter 2683), navigation.select-tab@1 (2723), media.open@2 APMP-180-example.mp4 (2926), playback.await-window-state@1 (3072), format.apply@2 flat/mono summonControls true (3108) and accessibility.activate@2 window with dismissControls true identifiers PlayerUI-window-playback-surface, PlayerUI-TopAction-videoFormat, PlayerUI-VideoFormat-automatic, PlayerUI-VideoFormat-apply (2725). The bound window.control-plane from diagnostics.surface-probe@1 call 07 (2856) is readable because the scenario stays in window/portal per product.md:17, and rubric:presentation-tour.automatic-source-provenance.o01@1 criteria 1-2 compare relatedResults[0] before and [1] after plus [2] transaction response via inlined fields without cross-case conjunction, with named formatProvenance source vs userOverride.

Two independent cases share one attempt via ordered app.relaunch@1 at call 09. Panoramic-to-portal uses 180_3D.mp4 and equirectangular180/mono (format.apply@2 3108) and flat-to-window uses sdr-bframe-multiaudio-avsync-120s.mp4 and flat/mono, each with transition-trace.arm@1 (3179), format.apply, fetch@1 (3191) with generationToken result reference, disarm@1 (3193). Obligations bind transition.trace@1 from fetch calls 07 and 15, each decidable via oracle:agent-structured-transition@1, and rubric:presentation-tour.format-application-route.o01@1 criteria 1-2 check media identity and arm->apply->settlement->fetch->disarm ordering with portal vs window geometry, without reusing identity or stale revision.

Window case producer call 06 accessibility.activate@2 with alsoInspect [PlayerUI-VideoFormat, PlayerUI-VideoFormat-automatic, PlayerUI-VideoFormat-apply, PlayerUI-VideoFormat-cancel] and dismissControls true plus inlined relatedResults[0..1] from call 05 proves editor appears only at videoFormat step inside one tapSequence; portal case producer call 15 inlines Playback surface label response and videoFormat->cancel responses because portal chrome lives outside main-window hierarchy per product.md:21 and only tap return evidence is admissible. Both obligations bind accessibility.tree@1 via oracle:agent-structured-accessibility-tree@1, and rubric:presentation-tour.format-editor-hosts-window-and-portal.o01@1 checks dismissControls on every surface tap and alsoInspected exists=false after surface and true after videoFormat.

Four cases are ordered via 30 calls: source-flat sdr-bframe-multiaudio-avsync-120s.mp4 window, source-panorama APMP-180-example.mp4 either-main-window, persisted-flat and persisted-panorama with relatedResults inlining diagnostics.playback-state@1 (2996) sourceIdentity/contentRevision from calls 16 and 26 after format.apply@2 (3108). Obligations bind window.control-plane@1 from media.open@2 calls 03,08,19,29 via oracle:agent-structured-window-control-plane@1, and rubric:presentation-tour.initial-presentation-routing.o01@1 checks route per case and character-for-character sourceIdentity/contentRevision equality for persisted cases, with formatProvenance userOverride vs source, without sharing override state.

Sequence app.relaunch@1, navigation.select-tab@1, media.open@2 sdr-bframe-multiaudio-avsync-120s.mp4 window, playback.await-window-state@1, format.apply@2 equirectangular180/mono summonControls true, presentation.enter-panorama@1 summonControls true (3162, which internally summons via toggleControls before tapping PlayerUI-TopAction-resumePanorama per task), then transition-trace.arm@1, presentation.exit-spatial@1 from panorama deadline 30 (3177), fetch/disarm with generationToken result reference. Bound window.control-plane from exit-spatial call 08 is readable after returning to portal per product.md:17, and rubric:presentation-tour.panorama-to-portal-exit.o01@1 checks PlayerPanel-button-exit-spatial after toggleControls and final presentation=portal attached=portal transition=none pendingSpatialEffect=none with position delta <=5s via spatialState fields.

Portal path uses files tab, media.open sdr-bframe-aggregate, await window, format.apply equirectangular180/mono to reach portal, then three accessibility.activate@2 portal transactions to open, cancel editor and probe coexistence: producer call 09 with alsoInspect [PlayerUI-TopAction-resumePanorama, PlayerUI-TopAction-videoFormat], dismissControls true and identifiers PlayerUI-TopAction-resumePanorama plus label Playback surface. Bound accessibility.tree@1 from call 09 via oracle:agent-structured-accessibility-tree@1 is admissible per product.md:21 portal chrome outside main-window tree, and rubric:presentation-tour.portal-format-and-panorama-actions-coexist.o01@1 checks exists/enabled/hittable for both siblings after label:Playback surface and tappedIdentifiers contains only resumePanorama.

Portal baseline via media.open sdr-bframe-multiaudio-avsync-120s.mp4 window then format.apply equirectangular180, then transition-trace.arm@1 and presentation.enter-panorama@1 summonControls true deadline 30. Bound transition.trace@1 from enter-panorama call 07 via oracle:agent-structured-transition@1 contains preActionMatchedElement identifier PlayerUI-TopAction-resumePanorama label Enter Panorama isEnabled/isHittable true (criterion 1) and application-side delivery then presentation request, attachment ownership transfer and panorama settlement for same revision (criterion 2) per rubric:presentation-tour.portal-to-panorama-explicit-entry.o01@1. Negative controls forbid controller-only success and copy from summon tap.

Lane simulator with input.device-hub-prepare@1 (3200) then for each of four cases docked-show, docked-hide, panorama-show, panorama-hide a fresh baseline via app.relaunch, media.open sdr-bframe-multiaudio-avsync-120s.mp4 or APMP with format.apply then diagnostics.surface-probe@1 (2856) cursorToken and input.device-hub-pinch@2 canvas with shotX 720 shotY 450 shotWidth 1440 shotHeight 900 targetDomain canvas (3202, x<width y<height per _device_hub validation). Obligations bind interaction.trace@1 from surface-probe calls 09,18,27,37 via oracle:agent-structured-interaction-trace@1, and rubric:presentation-tour.spatial-controls-summon.o01@1 quantifies exactly one accepted spatialTap for show and two ordered for hide, each naming real entity before toggle source=spatialTap with placement before enablement.

Four cases seek, window-docked-window, window-portal-window, format-replacement share one device attempt: each opens WebDAV sdr-bframe-aggregate-30s.mkv via FileBrowsing-grid, awaits window, then two accessibility.activate@2 window tapSequences with alsoInspect PlayerUI-TopAction-more and identifiers PlayerUI-TopAction-more, PlayerUI-menu-audio, PlayerUI-menu-audio-2 and labelsAfterIdentifiers for subtitle sdr-bframe-aggregate-30s.zh-CN.srt. Bound playback.probe@1 from diagnostics.playback-state@1 calls 09,19,29,38 via oracle:agent-structured-playback-probe@1 includes relatedResults inlining alsoInspected/response, and rubric:presentation-tour.track-selection-survives-seek-and-presentation.o01@1 checks ordering and preservation of media identity and selected audio/subtitle track identities after mutation.

Prepares window baseline via media.open sdr-bframe-... then format.apply equirectangular180, then transition-trace.arm@1 fault settlement-timeout (3179 allowed fault string), then presentation.enter-panorama@1 expectedResult rollback-after-settlement-timeout summonControls true (3162). Bound transition.trace@1 from disarm call 09 via oracle:agent-structured-transition@1 includes terminal state after spatial-surface-settlement-failed, and rubric:presentation-tour.transition-timeout-rolls-back.o01@1 checks consumed one-shot fault and portal reattachment with transition none pendingSpatialEffect none lifecycle Playing surfaceAttachmentFailed visible presentationRolledBack recorded.

Window baseline via media.open sdr-bframe-multiaudio-avsync-120s.mp4 window, await window, then transition-trace.arm@1, presentation.enter-docked-skybox@1 deadline 30 (3152), presentation.exit-spatial@1 from docked deadline 30 (3177), fetch/disarm with generationToken. Bound window.control-plane@1 from exit-spatial call 07 via oracle:agent-structured-window-control-plane@1 is readable after returning to window per product.md:17, and rubric:presentation-tour.window-docked-round-trip.o01@1 checks spatialState attached=docked and fields after exit presentation=window attached=window same session and windowGeometryPolicyKind aspectLocked resizingRestriction uniform.
